Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties. Trip TRP-02842, Northpoint City to Blk 215 Bedok North St 1, booked at 12.0 km optimal and driven 14.44 km on the GPS trace.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 2.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Rider advocate14 claim(s), 13 kept

  1. The governing distance measurement is the GPS trace, not the rounded copy on the trip record.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-01 states that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace figure governs and the trip-record copy may NOT be cited for the threshold test. Here the trace measures 14.44 km against a booked optimal of 12.0 km, and the two fields straddle the 20% gate: 14.44 km is an excess of 2.44 km or 20.333%, which passes, while the rounded 14.4 km would give exactly 20.0% and fail. That straddle is exactly the situation POL-RD-01's drafting note anticipates, so the trace figure is the only safe basis for the finding.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842 · POL-RD-01

  2. Both limbs of the POL-RD-01 establishment gate are satisfied on this trip's own trace.

    Read the whole claim

    The excess over the booked optimal route is 2.44 km, which is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and it is 20.333% of the 12.0 km optimal, which is greater than the 20% proportional threshold. Both tests pass, so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED and POL-RD-01 itself says that if it were otherwise the outcome would be NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The excess is 2.44 km or 20.33%, which is well below the 50% and 8.0 km figures, so it is an established but not a MATERIAL deviation.

    EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842 · POL-RD-01

  3. The deviation is not established on broken data.

    Read the whole claim

    The trace carries 114 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval with 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met: there is no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m and no sustained interval above 30 seconds. The trace is therefore NOT impaired for policy purposes, and the rider may establish the deviation on the trace alone without the independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) would otherwise demand.

    EV-GPS-02842 · POL-RD-07

  4. The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged on both limbs.

    Read the whole claim

    As to (a), the trip identifiers match across the artifacts - trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry TRP-02842 - and the timestamps agree: the trace's first fix is 2026-08-24T06:34:18+08:00, identical to trip_record.started_at, and the fare was charged at 06:53:33, 25 seconds after the trip ended at 06:53:08. As to (b), the excess of 2.44 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden has therefore shifted to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause.

    EV-TRIP-02842, EV-GPS-02842, EV-FARE-02842 · POL-RD-08

  5. No additional corroboration burden attaches to this claim.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-08 raises the rider's corroboration requirement only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer. This rider's 60-day deviation claim count is 0 and the substantiated count is 0, so the corroboration uplift is not engaged and the trace alone carries the excess.

    EV-RPROF-02842 · POL-RD-08

  6. The driver's explanation does not discharge his burden.

    Read the whole claim

    His statement says only that there was a 'Minor detour because of a road works sign' - an uncited assertion of an external traffic cause. Under POL-RD-13 such an assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle's only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02842-01, is IMPAIRED to the point of absence: its status is MISSING, it has no payload, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired with the detail that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. I cite that artifact for its absence and disclose the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. With no advisory on file, POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all - there is no named road, no validity window and no shortest lawful alternative to apply the 130% cap to - and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

    EV-ADVIS-02842-01 · POL-RD-13, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-08

  7. The missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and it does not send this case to a human reviewer.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-13(1) is explicit: where the asserting party names no evidence ID for an advisory, the missing advisory is NOT an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5), because an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one.   12. The refund is arithmetic.

    Read the whole claim

    Under POL-RD-02 recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 16.0) x the surge multiplier recorded on the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + on-optimal-route ERP and tolls + waiting_time_fee - promo_discount. That is (3.80 + 9.00 + 4.48) x 1.0 = 17.28, plus 0.80 = 18.08. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and is 1.0, not absent; optimal-route ERP is 0.00, waiting_time_fee is 0.0 and promo_discount is 0.0. Refund = charged_total 20.66 - recomputed_fare 18.08 = 2.58 before rounding, which is rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 and becomes SGD 2.60 payable. The refund is not below the SGD 0.50 de minimis, and at 12.5% of charged_total it is nowhere near the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60 - which at least covers the SGD 2.00 the rider contested. The ruling should state charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund on separate lines.

To both parties. Trip TRP-02842, Northpoint City to Blk 215 Bedok North St 1, booked at 12.0 km optimal and driven 14.44 km on the GPS trace. DISTANCE AND DEVIATION. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace figure the governing measurement where it and the trip-record copy disagree, and here they do: the trip record's rounded 14.4 km would be exactly 20.0% over the optimal route and would fail the proportional gate, while the trace's 14.44 km is an excess of 2.44 km, or 20.333% of 12.0 km, and clears both tests (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%). A route deviation is therefore ESTABLISHED at 2.44 km. It is not a MATERIAL deviation — 2.44 km is far below both the 50% and the 8.0 km materiality figures — so the materiality limb of POL-RD-06 is not reached. TRACE INTEGRITY. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met. No gap-handling adjustment applies, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The statement that this was a 'minor detour because of a road works sign' is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02842-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run at all: there is no named road, no validity window to compare against the trace and no shortest lawful alternative to apply the 130% cap to. Under POL-RD-08 the assertion discharges nothing, and under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the measured figure and the refund runs against the booked 12.0 km optimal route. Because no advisory identifier was named for the assertion, POL-RD-13(1) applies and the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. ADJUSTING CLAUSES. The chat log for this trip is empty (0 messages), so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint; POL-RD-04 excludes nothing and POL-RD-14 does not arise. There is no pickup or dropoff amendment timestamp and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 does not apply. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply. The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02. THE MONEY (POL-RD-02). - charged_total: SGD 20.66 - recomputed_fare: (3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 km = 9.00 + 0.28 x 16.0 min = 4.48) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP/tolls + 0.00 waiting-time fee - 0.00 promo discount = SGD 18.08 - refund: 20.66 - 18.08 = SGD 2.58, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 2.60. SGD 2.60 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 12.5% of the charge, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60. NOTHING IS ADDED ON TOP. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), so POL-RD-09 produces no separate pass-through correction and POL-RD-09(1)'s anti-double-count rule bites on nothing; there is no billing-integrity defect and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. On the compensation limb of POL-RD-04, the rider was billed for 14.4 km against the trace's 14.44 km — a shortfall of 0.04 km, well under the 1.0 km threshold — so no driver compensation is payable. PROFILE CHECK AND REFERRALS. Even taking the case at its most finely balanced, the POL-RD-06 check comes back clean: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 396, so the count is below 3 and the ratio is 0.0, below 0.05. No repeat pattern is established, so there is no shift of the balance to the rider, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is context only under POL-GEN-01; it was not used as a ground, and the claim that says so is accepted. CONFIDENCE. Every artifact the ruling rests on — the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02842), the trip record (EV-TRIP-02842) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02842) — carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. AUDIT. One claim from each side, both bearing on the missing advisory, was discarded by the referee for citing the impaired artifact without naming its issue code; that is recorded in the discarded claims list. EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect of SGD 2.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it is executed automatically on issue. This ruling is provisional and was made without human review; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
